question: All 20 students of a class are standing in a straight row facing north. Shilpa is 7th from the right end, while Nikhil is 18th from the left end. How many students are standing between Shilpa and Nikhil?
solution:
The following seating arrangement is as follows:

There are 20 students of a class standing in a straight row facing north.

1) Shilpa is 7th from the right end

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac7d373980aca915cb6d452c22e1c229f1b013c1621ea217d6eba7f664c82b25.png] 

2) Nikhil is 18th from the left end

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc5cd5b1496f357ad5b3da57155b9321c4f76a780efe844d4657b2c9221d24b7.png] 

So the final arrangement,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ab5fc22e1000d2165b193b28374816b38b9876090fd199b4b7f1ddafb4b8bfd.png] 

So as per the arrangement **3** students are sitting between Shilpa and Nikhil.

Hence, the correct answer is **"3".**
